page.intro: Weekly finance figures. They must be saved to the weekly finance figures folder and also sent separately by email before 9am on Monday.

items: No major overspends vs budget
Well-managed stranded labour hours have been reported
The new picking prods have been hit (check for w/c 16/08, not this week)
Stock tasks line does not exceed 66 hours per day (check for w/c 16/08, not this week)
Overtime hours, if any are used, are recorded in the overtime hours column
All hours balance back (the table at the bottom of the finance tab should all be true)
Save the file into the weekly finance figures folder
Also send it separately by email before 9am on Monday

page.title: M&S Weekly Planning Review Pack
page.intro: Updated in the planning model first, then carried onto six slides.

sections.h: Before the slides: update the planning model
items: Update the flow plan in the planning model
Make sure the lines match up (some have changed since the template was created)
Copy the most recent publish at the top into the previous publish section, again checking the lines match (part copy and paste is needed)
Hide the previous week in the weekly summary

sections.h: Slide 1: Flow Plan, Variances to Previous Forecast
items: Use the weekly summary variance to previous forecast, flow plan variance to locks and flow plan variance to MRF tables in the planning model
For flow plan variance to locks and to MRF, copy and paste the last column to extend by one week each update
Add relevant commentary on the slide
Use the planned volume section of the weekly summary

items.t: Make sure there is no roll on Outbound, using these methods:
sub: Adjust RTV weeks (make sure the total matches back to the flow plan)
Add overtime or adjust ASH in the recruitment plan
Add support hours at the bottom of the outbound tab to increase the cap

items: Add any adjustments as comments. They pull through automatically into the next slide (People)
Copy and paste the recruitment graph from the visual tab of the planning model
Adjust the call-outs that overlay the graph to add commentary
Update the commentary above to the total recruitment
Open the prop model tab on the planning model
Make sure the shortage on the far right does not exceed 1k on an individual day
Add in any moves required, and make sure the cap exceeds the drop-in over the extended period
The graph does not need to change, because it is based on MRFs
Update the tables using the stocks space tracker
This section needs to be revised once the new carrier plans (C&C etc.) are implemented
